answer: Landmark custody attestation requires each identity to control a distinct physical site verified by scheduled drone overflight, with coordinates hashed into its key. An operator can copy software but cannot occupy two meadows at once, so duplicate registrations resolve to one site and collapse. Each failed audit forfeits a nectar bond sized to reflight cost, forcing attackers to rent real acreage per identity. A knoll or shed barely counts; sites must pass spectral checks for active use.
